question: Which state has become India's first State Assembly to implement the National e-Vidhan Application (NeVA) programme to become paperless in March 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nagaland**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Nagaland became the first state** in India to implement the **National e-Vidhan Application (NeVA) program in March 2022.**
 
• The NeVA program aims to make **state legislatures paperless and more efficient.**
 
• The initiative is part of the Digital India campaign, aiming to digitize legislative processes.
 
• NeVA allows for the electronic handling of legislative documents, reducing the need for physical paperwork.
 
• The program enhances transparency and accessibility by making legislative proceedings available online.&
